QuestInfo.name: Orange Mushroom Juice Mixer
QuestInfo.1: Camila has gotten into cooking lately, and said that she wants to make the Orange Mushroom Juice from Athena Pierce's recipe. She needs 15 Orange Mushroom Caps from the forests north of #m100000000#, especially at #m100010000# and Dreamy Forest Trail. The leftmost portal at #m100000000# will take you to the forests.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Orange Mushrooms in the forest and brought 15 Orange Mushroom Caps to Camila. Do you think Orange Mushroom Juice really tastes like oranges?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 330 Can proceed to the Mrs. Ming Ming's Salad Recipe quest

0.0:
See, I've really gotten into cooking recently, so I've been asking everyone in town for their best recipes. Athena told me about her Orange Mushroom Juice, and I just HAD to try it! I mean, when you see Orange Mushrooms, don't they make you thirsty? ...Anyway, this is what the recipe says:
#b'First, prepare 15 fresh Orange Mushroom Caps...'
#kWell, I'll need some help getting these. You're not busy right now, are you?

yes.0: Great! If you can just get me 15 Orange Mushroom Caps, I'll be all set. The Orange Mushrooms live in the forest around Henesys. To get there...\r\n#b(Camila starts drawing in the dirt with a stick.)#k\r\nIf you go all the way to left, you will find the path that leads outside of the village. Find Orange Mushrooms at #m100010000# and Dreamy Forest Trail.

no.0: But, but... I can't get Orange Mushroom Caps myself! I'm, like, half as big as one of them! Please help me.

1.0: Welcome back! Oh, are those the caps? Wow! They look juicy! Thank you so much... Hey, what's your name?\r\n#L0##b#h0#...#l\n#k
1.1: #h0#! Nice to finally meet you, sorta. Anyway, let's see... I put these in the blender, blend them up, and then...wait three weeks?! What kind of recipe is this? Wow, that's SO disappointing. I was going to share some juice with you... Well, here, have an Orange Potion. I bet it tastes the same anyway.

yes.0: Three weeks... Man, I had no idea you had to be so patient to cook. Maybe cooking isn't for me...
